scope: Wire the prebuilt StrictR3Final14State into the canonical feature graph as a bounded two-phase append. The hook loads an existing hash-bound snapshot only, resolves frozen spectral and OI parent identities from cfg, captures contiguous unseen non-spectral parents, rebuilds the frozen spectral source from post-transform feature values in the declared order, snapshots atomically, and publishes exactly the fourteen declared outputs. It does not bootstrap state, modify materializer/live configs, touch order-book/composite logic, or run live inference.

commands: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/tmp/ares_pycache NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/numba_cache python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_market_spectral_feature_state.py tests/test_spectral_oi_geometry_state.py tests/test_strict_r3_final14_state.py

evidence.post_transform_boundary: canonical ret1h is read only after causal transformation; spectral source values are rebuilt from post-transform feats at apply time
evidence.spectral_parent_identity: frozen selected columns are loaded from the cfg-declared spectral source artifact, matched exactly to the restored state, and enforced in frozen order
evidence.spectral_failure_atomicity: a deliberate spectral child failure preserves the pre-update in-memory watermark, leaves the persisted state byte-identical, and publishes no partial final-14 replacements
evidence.oi_parent_identity: ordered cfg MODEL_REGIME_COMPOSITE_EIGEN_GROUPS.open_interest parents are matched exactly to the restored state

validation.decision: The hook remains disabled until a canonical snapshot is built from an exact pre-transform parent ledger and proves full 120-field plus downstream score/admission/policy parity. A bounded request is never accepted as a bootstrap source.

agent_plan.delegation_note: Bounded semantic-boundary integration retained locally; no delegation.
